final.title: State of the Vertical Farming Market: Size, Key Players, and Economics
final.summary:
The vertical farming market was valued at $6.3 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach $11.8 billion by 2030, indicating strong growth despite a recent industry shakeout. The sector is dominated by leafy greens, which account for 71% of production. However, the industry faced significant challenges in 2024 when two large operators went bankrupt, primarily due to high energy costs. Energy now represents 38% of a typical vertical farm's operating expenses.

Key companies include Canopy Grid, which raised $140 million in Series C funding to build a 9-hectare facility near Rotterdam (the largest in Europe), and Tierra Vertical, which operates 14 smaller farms across Spain and Portugal. The industry is consolidating as weaker players exit the market.

Economically, vertical farming remains expensive compared to traditional agriculture. In 2025, lettuce from vertical farms cost approximately $3.90 per kg to produce, versus $1.60 per kg for field-grown lettuce. Horticultural LED efficiency reached 3.4 micromoles per joule, but the cost gap persists. The two biggest levers to improve profitability are lower electricity prices and higher automation levels.

final.title: Green Hydrogen Electrolyzer Market Summary
final.summary: The green hydrogen electrolyzer market is in early growth stages, with shipments reaching 4.1 GW (worth $5.2 billion) in 2025 and forecast to grow to $14.5 billion by 2030. Alkaline electrolyzers currently dominate with 58% of shipments, while PEM electrolyzers hold 36%. China accounts for 61% of global manufacturing capacity. Key suppliers include Voltagen (the largest PEM supplier outside China with a 19% share), Electra Hydro (alkaline systems), and Nordlys Systems (solid-oxide electrolyzers). Electricity accounts for roughly 70% of production costs. Technical barriers include stack degradation and low utilisation rates caused by the intermittent nature of renewable energy sources powering electrolyzers.

final.title: Overview of the Post-Quantum Cryptography Market
final.summary: The post-quantum cryptography (PQC) market is experiencing rapid growth, with spending reaching $820 million in 2025 and forecast to grow to $4.3 billion by 2030. This represents a significant expansion driven largely by the financial and public sectors; banks account for 34% of spending, while government agencies make up 29%. The market is currently led by Latticeguard, which holds a 26% market share, followed by Q-Shield with 18% after beginning shipments of quantum-safe hardware security modules in late 2025. Despite this growth, adoption faces significant hurdles. A survey of 400 large organizations revealed that only 12% have a complete inventory of their cryptographic assets, complicating migration efforts. Additionally, the transition is slowed by technical challenges, primarily the larger key sizes required by PQC algorithms and the presence of legacy hardware that cannot be easily updated or patched.

final.title: eVTOL Air Taxi Market Forecast for 2028
final.summary: There are two conflicting estimates for the eVTOL air taxi market size in 2028, depending on how broadly the market is defined. Skyline Research forecasts the passenger-focused eVTOL air taxi market at $1.2 billion in 2028 (with growth to $9.8 billion by 2033). MarketPulse projects a significantly larger market of $3.5 billion in 2028, nearly three times higher, because it includes cargo drones and pilot training alongside passenger air taxi services. Notably, no eVTOL air taxi service was in commercial operation at the end of 2025, indicating that these forecasts represent early-stage market entry expectations.

findings.claim: Skyline Research forecasts the eVTOL air taxi market at $1.2 billion in 2028 and $9.8 billion by 2033.
No eVTOL air taxi service was in commercial operation at the end of 2025, with order books across all manufacturers totaling 7,400 aircraft.
MarketPulse projects the eVTOL air taxi market at $3.5 billion in 2028, nearly three times other forecasts, because it counts cargo drones and pilot training alongside passenger services.

final.title: Quantor Cells 2019 Revenue
final.summary: The available sources do not contain information regarding Quantor Cells' revenue in 2019. The company appears to be a recent entrant in the solid-state battery market, with its major facility opening in March 2026 and its market share data only being reported for 2025. There is no financial data available for the year 2019.

findings.claim: Quantor Cells opened a 12 GWh solid-state battery plant in Leipzig, Germany, in March 2026.
Quantor Cells is reported to have an estimated 27% share of 2025 solid-state battery revenue.
